game: Week 4 2026 NYJ@CHI / kickoff time not in pack / spread and total not saved / weather not saved

script.base: No spread or total is saved, so the script is inferred from form and the injury report only. Caleb Williams is out, so Chicago should be more run-heavy than the already Swift-led sample (54 carries, 253 yards) with Tyson Bagent in a first 2026 start and LT Braxton Jones out, which points to shorter throws rather than explosives. New York is without Breece Hall and Adonai Mitchell, so the Jets' offense funnels through Garrett Wilson in the pass game and a Braelon Allen-led run game that has not shown starter efficiency. Base case is a competitive, lower-play game: Chicago runs Swift to stay on schedule, New York has to throw to Wilson because the skill-position replacements are thin.
script.flip1: Chicago leads late. Swift's carries go up as they run clock, and Wilson's targets also go up because the Jets have to chase without Hall. Both overs can survive this flip. Bagent dropbacks may stall if the lead is safe, which would hurt Chicago pass-catchers, not Swift.
script.flip2: New York leads big. Chicago abandons the run, Swift's carry total dies, and the Jets can grind clock with Allen, which stalls Wilson the same way a clock-killing favorite stalls its own QB and WR. Shared kill for both legs. A second mess flip is both offensive lines (Jones, Parham) losing the snap and the game becoming a sack/three-and-out slog under any reasonable total.

injury_fallout: Source: pack official pre-game injury report (nflverse), known before kickoff; final inactives ~90 minutes prior are not in the pack. Adonai Mitchell Out (finger) removes 15 targets / 123 yards / 237 air yards; the on-field absorbers are Garrett Wilson (already 27 targets / 243 yards) and Isaiah Williams (9/62), plus Jeremy Ruckert (8/48) if Kenyon Sadiq (Questionable, back; 14 targets / 143 yards) sits or is limited. Dylan Parham Out (knee) should cut rush efficiency and push quicker throws. Mason Taylor Out (thumb). Francisco Mauigoa Out (quad) softens the second level for Chicago's run and short pass game. CHI: Caleb Williams Out (hamstring) is the script-changer; Tyson Bagent has a rush prop and no prior 2026 games, and Case Keenum is only 2 rushes / 8 yards in the sample, so Bagent is the presumed starter without a verified depth-chart line. Braxton Jones Out (knee) should raise pressure and cut deep WR yards. Kyler Gordon Out (calf) and Cam Lewis Doubtful (hip) are the coverage losses that help NYJ slot and deep options. Noah Sewell Out (Achilles) and Shemar Turner Out (knee) soften the front Chicago would have used to stop Allen. Who loses: Odunze's 17.2 aDOT profile, and any Jets run over that needs Hall's 17 carries at league efficiency.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting in the pack, so MOFO/MOFC and man/zone rates are unknown (step 4 limited). Proxy from location splits only: CHI allows 7.03 YPA left (32 throws), 8.42 middle (19), 8.24 right (33). NYJ allows 6.03 left (34), 7.82 middle (22), 4.78 right (37).
matchup.pressure: CHI blitz rate 42%. NYJ EPA/dropback is better vs blitz (0.34) than vs no blitz (0.16), so Chicago pressure does not profile as a Wilson-killer on this sample. NYJ blitz rate 35%. CHI EPA/dropback vs blitz 0.37 vs 0.08 was with Caleb Williams and does not transfer to Bagent. Both teams have an offensive lineman out (Braxton Jones, Dylan Parham), which should lift pressure, cut deep yards, and tilt both offenses toward runs and quick throws.
matchup.bleeds: CHI run defense allows 5.09 YPC and 9 runs of 10+, plus 8 passes of 20+ for 91 yards; the pass bleed is middle and right. NYJ run defense is tighter at 4.40 YPC with only 6 runs of 10+ and only 4 passes of 20+ (101 yards); their pass bleed is the middle, and the right side is a strength.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlap is Wilson, the Jets' primary target (27 targets, 284 air yards, 10.5 aDOT), into a CHI secondary missing slot CB Gordon and possibly S Lewis, on a defense that has already allowed 8 explosives and 8-plus YPA middle and right. Chicago's best overlap without Caleb is Swift's carry share into a Jets front missing Mauigoa, not into a soft run defense (4.40 YPC). Odunze's 224 air yards on 13 targets attack the part of the NYJ defense that has not bled.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Wilson under 75.5: Chicago bracketed him with Gordon's replacement and a safety, Mitchell's 15 targets went to Isaiah Williams (already 9 targets) and Ruckert, Sadiq played and was the mismatch vs Sewell/Gordon, and 75.5 was his median not a discount — the 57-yard game is the template when they take the WR1 away. Swift under 64.5: Monangai out-touched him because he has been the more efficient back (5.93 vs 4.69 YPC), Jones' absence blew up the left side, the Jets' 4.40 YPC front stuffed the 10-yard runs (only 6 allowed in three games), and Bagent three-and-outs capped team carries — the 45-yard game is the template. The counter is strong enough to keep both at lean and flagged, not strong enough to erase the role math (Wilson's target funnel is real; 64.5 is still 20 under Swift's mean). Allen was the trap the other way and stays off the card.
slip_story: One story, not two: competitive or Chicago-ahead game in which Bagent cannot be asked to win it through the air, so Swift carries, and the Jets cannot lean on Hall or Mitchell, so Wilson targets. Those two legs win together in the base script and in the Chicago-leads flip. Do not add a total under, an Odunze or Burden over, or an Allen rush over to this ticket — Allen needs New York to lead and run, which is the flip that kills Swift. No TD legs, no second market on either player. If the late inactive sheet flips Sadiq to Out or Bagent to inactive, re-run before kickoff; that window is not in this pack.
